import random
import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import RisingEdge, FallingEdge, Timer
from multigent.verifier_tool.coverage.runtime import contract_coverage, sample_operation
from reference.uadd8_ref import uadd8_to_u9

COVERAGE_OBLIGATIONS = {
    "channel.in_chan.handshake_states",
    "channel.in_chan.stall_stability",
    "channel.out_chan.handshake_states",
    "channel.out_chan.stall_stability",
    "signal.rst_n.reset_behavior",
    "operation.uadd_pair.opcode",
    "operation.uadd_pair.vector_length",
    "operation.uadd_pair.operand_classes",
    "operation.uadd_pair.numeric_behavior",
    "operation.uadd_pair.predication",
    "operation.uadd_pair.fixed_opcode_add_only",
    "operation.uadd_pair.scalar_single_element_per_transaction",
    "operation.uadd_pair.no_predication_supported",
}

STIMULUS_COVERAGE_INTENTS = [
    {"label": "boundary_and_latency", "targets": ["channel.in_chan.handshake_states", "channel.out_chan.handshake_states", "operation.uadd_pair.numeric_behavior", "operation.uadd_pair.vector_length", "operation.uadd_pair.scalar_single_element_per_transaction"]},
    {"label": "input_stall_1", "targets": ["channel.in_chan.stall_stability", "operation.uadd_pair.opcode", "operation.uadd_pair.fixed_opcode_add_only"]},
    {"label": "input_stall_short", "targets": ["channel.in_chan.stall_stability", "operation.uadd_pair.operand_classes"]},
    {"label": "input_stall_long", "targets": ["channel.in_chan.stall_stability"]},
    {"label": "output_stall_1", "targets": ["channel.out_chan.stall_stability", "operation.uadd_pair.no_predication_supported", "operation.uadd_pair.predication"]},
    {"label": "output_stall_short", "targets": ["channel.out_chan.stall_stability"]},
    {"label": "output_stall_long", "targets": ["channel.out_chan.stall_stability"]},
    {"label": "reset_idle", "targets": ["signal.rst_n.reset_behavior"]},
    {"label": "reset_during_pending", "targets": ["signal.rst_n.reset_behavior"]},
    {"label": "randomized_stream", "targets": ["operation.uadd_pair.operand_classes", "operation.uadd_pair.numeric_behavior"]},
]

OPERATION_SAMPLING_BINDINGS = [
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.opcode", "template": "discrete_mode", "event": "clock", "fields": {"value": {"signal": "in_valid", "lsb": 0, "width": 1}}, "legal_values": [1]},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.vector_length", "template": "dimension", "event": "clock", "fields": {"value": {"signal": "in_valid", "lsb": 0, "width": 1}}, "dimension": "tx_elems"},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.operand_classes", "template": "integer_operand", "event": "transfer", "channel": "in_chan", "fields": {"value": {"signal": "in_op_a", "lsb": 0, "width": 8}}, "data_type": "u8"},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.numeric_behavior", "template": "integer_add_overflow", "event": "transfer", "channel": "in_chan", "fields": {"a": {"signal": "in_op_a", "lsb": 0, "width": 8}, "b": {"signal": "in_op_b", "lsb": 0, "width": 8}}, "operand_types": {"a": "u8", "b": "u8"}, "result_type": "u9"},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.predication", "template": "boolean_mode", "event": "clock", "fields": {"value": {"signal": "in_valid", "lsb": 0, "width": 1}}, "legal_values": [1]},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.fixed_opcode_add_only", "template": "discrete_mode", "event": "clock", "fields": {"value": {"signal": "in_valid", "lsb": 0, "width": 1}}, "legal_values": [1]},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.scalar_single_element_per_transaction", "template": "dimension", "event": "clock", "fields": {"value": {"signal": "in_valid", "lsb": 0, "width": 1}}, "dimension": "tx_elems"},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.no_predication_supported", "template": "boolean_mode", "event": "clock", "fields": {"value": {"signal": "in_valid", "lsb": 0, "width": 1}}, "legal_values": [1]},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.in_chan_stall", "template": "channel_stall", "event": "transfer", "channel": "in_chan"},
    {"operation": "uadd_pair", "point": "operation.uadd_pair.out_chan_stall", "template": "channel_stall", "event": "transfer", "channel": "out_chan"}
]

# === LLM-GENERATED OPERATION ASSERTIONS ===

@cocotb.test(timeout_time=50, timeout_unit="us")
@contract_coverage()
async def test_smoke_executes(dut):
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.clk, 10, unit="ns").start())
    dut.rst_n.value = 0
    dut.in_valid.value = 0
    dut.out_ready.value = 0
    dut.in_op_a.value = 0
    dut.in_op_b.value = 0
    await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.rst_n.value = 1
    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.in_valid.value = 1
    dut.out_ready.value = 1
    dut.in_op_a.value = 5
    dut.in_op_b.value = 7
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
    await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
    assert int(dut.out_valid.value) in (0, 1)

coverpoints.description: Architect extension: one element per transaction.
Input channel stall durations via released stall length.
Output channel stall durations via released stall length.

verification_plan.pass_criteria: All cocotb tests pass, all declared interface/operation obligations are hit, exact oracle match for every accepted transaction, no protocol/accounting assertion failures.
protocol_assumptions: Ready/valid transfers occur only on rising edge with valid&&ready&&rst_n==1.
Source holds in_valid and payload stable while stalled.
Sink backpressure may toggle out_ready arbitrarily.
Reset is synchronous active-low and suppresses transfer acceptance on asserted edge.
